description: This PHP class 'MailTransport' provides an implementation for handling email transport mechanisms within the OrangeHRM system, utilizing Symfony's Mailer component. It supports different transport schemes like SMTP, secure SMTP, and sendmail, and offers methods to configure and send email messages.

classes.name: MailTransport
classes.description: A class extending Symfony's AbstractTransport to facilitate email sending with configurable transport schemes like SMTP, secure SMTP, and sendmail.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MailTransport instance, setting up the transport based on scheme, host, and port parameters.

methods.name: loadTransport
methods.description: Loads and initializes the actual transport object using the current configuration.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setEncryption
methods.description: Configures encryption options for the transport, e.g., TLS.

methods.name: doSend
methods.description: Performs the sending of the email message.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the transport.
